source_type: public-domain primary grammar, independent of VP
scope: Selected first-person singular present examples; not certification of every generated task. Section 1052 supplies the stem, with regular first-person inflection.

construction_support.1025: Causatives of intensives and desideratives of those causatives are grammatically permitted, though exceedingly rare in texts.
construction_support.1039: Causative formation can apply to desiderative stems.
construction_support.1052: Desiderative formation can apply to causative stems.

interpretation: This is a formal grammar benchmark, not a claim that every generated combination is attested in ordinary Sanskrit usage.
